## Remarks [#remarks]

Each type has two lanes (spec 066 §7.2). The plain lane holds controls whose composition visual was never taken. The visual lane holds controls whose visual was taken, reset to a fresh control's pixels by [`ElementPool.ResetTakenVisual`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/extensibility/ElementPool). Such a control still refuses the facade transforms and the XAML implicit transitions, so only an element that takes the visual itself and has no setters rents from it.

### `Enabled` [#enabled]

When false, TryRent always returns null and Return is a no-op. Useful for scenarios like the live previewer where recycled controls with stale property state can cause visual glitches.
